name: @twinsearth/dsh-gpw2
description: DSH-GPW2, Global Permission Watchdog for DeepSeek Harness: a global approval answerer with a hard budget. Auto-approves at most 10 permission requests per rolling 60 seconds, at least 3 seconds apart; anything past either limit is deferred to the human answerer and waits. It never refuses and never changes what is asked.
